stories.name: Hall and Woodford win the 2026 economics Nobel
facts: On Monday, October 12, 2026, the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel to Americans Robert Hall and Michael Woodford.
The citation: "for microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation."
The prize is worth 12 million Swedish crowns (about $1.2 million).

stories.name: Hurricane Simon and remnants of Rachel batter Mexico's Pacific coast
facts: Hurricane Simon weakened from Category 4 to Category 2 by late Monday morning, with winds near 155 km/h, off Jalisco.
A 71-year-old man died in Guerrero when a retaining wall collapsed during Simon; a young girl died in Baja California from the effects of Rachel, officials said.
At least 10 people were missing in Baja California, according to the state governor.
